title: Messages sent from you to others
Read messages sent by you to others
desc: If OFF, will read messages you send in game. If ON, will not read

title: NPC voices on/off
desc: Whether to play an NPC message using a randomly generated Cloud voice for that character.

title: Replace received NPC messages with variant phrases
desc: If ON, will replace the canned in-game NPC messages with variant phrases, if configured in the Speech Extensions file.  You will still see the original message in the Comms window in game, but will hear the alternate phrase.

title: NPC message throttle
desc: Ignore NPC message (so dont generate voice) if last NPC message was received < x seconds ago. Set to 0 if you want all messages and dont mind if voices overlap, else set to a reasonable ignore period

title: Direct message voices ON/OFF
desc: If Space Chatter is ON, whether to play Direct messages to you from Commanders using a randomly assigned Cloud voice.

title: Mute Direct messages
desc: If 'Direct message voices ON/OFF' above is OFF, the Ship AI will read Direct messages to you instead, unless you set this Mute option to ON

title: Squadron voices ON/OFF
desc: If Space Chatter is ON, whether to play Squadron messages using a randomly assigned Cloud voice.

title: Ship announces Squadron sender before voice plays?
desc: If ON, Ship AI will announce who the message is from before you hear the voice message.

title: Mute Squadron messages
desc: If 'Squadron voices ON/OFF' above is OFF, the Ship AI will read Squadron messages to you instead, unless you set this Mute option to ON

title: Team voices ON/OFF
desc: If Space Chatter is ON, whether to play Team messages using a randomly assigned Cloud voice.

title: Ship announces Team sender before voice plays?
desc: If ON, Ship AI will announce who the message is from before you hear the voice message.

title: Mute Team messages
desc: If 'Team voices ON/OFF' above is OFF, the Ship AI will read Team messages to you instead, unless you set this Mute option to ON

title: Local voices ON/OFF
desc: If Space Chatter is ON, whether to play Local channel messages using a randomly assigned Cloud voice.

title: Mute Local messages
desc: If 'Local voices ON/OFF' above is OFF, the Ship AI will read Local messages to you instead, unless you set this Mute option to ON

title: StarSystem voices ON/OFF
desc: If Space Chatter is ON, whether to play StarSystem channel messages using a randomly assigned Cloud voice.

title: Mute StarSystem messages
desc: If 'StarSystem voices ON/OFF' above is OFF, the Ship AI will read Local messages to you instead, unless you set this Mute option to ON

title: Play notification beep if message announcements are MUTED
desc: If ON and Mute Direct or Mute Squadon are ON, will play a beep to let you know there is a message. If OFF, no beep!

title: Print received messages
desc: If ON, will print the incoming message to the voice log.
